shortDescription: Manages the configuration of an Interface's Power over Ethernet.

options.name: allocate_by_method
options.description: Configure the power allocation method for the PoE Interface. The choices are 'usage' and 'class'.

options.name: assigned_class
options.description: Assigned class (power limit) for the PoE Interface. The choices are 3, 4, 6 and 8.

options.name: enable
options.description: Configurable flag to control PoE power delivery on this Interface. A value of true would enable PoE power delivery on this Interface. By default, the flag is set to false for all PoE capable Interfaces.

options.name: interface
options.description: The name of an interface available inside a switch

options.name: pd_class_override
options.description: Enable PD requested class override by user assigned class.

options.name: pre_standard_detect
options.description: Enable detection of pre-standard PoE devices.

options.name: priority
options.description: Power priority level for the PoE Interface. The choices are 'low', 'high', and 'critical'.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, update or delete the Interface's PoE configuration.
